signal: Sohra maximum three-day IMERG rainfall during the season, from the existing hindcast CSV
labelPolicy: Primary: explicit yes, late or short are positive; explicit no is negative. Not stated, absent reports and the June-only account for 2015 remain unknown. Do not read the hindcast's derived flash_flood column as independent truth.

sensitivityAnalyses.excludeBroad2019Label: The 2019 short label covers a broad northeastern and southeastern region, without a local arrival date. Repeat without it.
sensitivityAnalyses.includeIndirect2004Label: The existing hindcast infers 2004 from the 2010 report's comparison with 2004. Include it only as a separate sensitivity result.

limitations: This audits checked-in FFWC report extractions, not newly verified gauge observations. Labels are regional and do not establish flooding at an individual farm.
Thresholds and this historical series were already explored by the project. All existing thresholds are reported; none is selected or tuned here. This is not held-out forecast validation.
A same-season rainfall burst can occur after flooding. Arrival dates are unavailable, so seasonal association cannot establish warning lead time or timely crop protection.
IMERG Final historical rainfall is retrospective. Operational latency, provisional rainfall, gauge confirmation and message delivery are not evaluated.
Unknown years are excluded from confusion counts, never treated as no flood. Precision and recall apply only to this small, selectively labeled sample.
Always-watch and never-watch are seasonal reference policies, not reconstructions of an agricultural officer's advice. No threshold or production alert is changed by this audit.
